Oh, we rarely have visitors here. Welcome to Draco\nTown! It's the town of the weredragons and may be\na little bit uncomfortable for people like you.
Yeah, we live a self-sufficient life and there\naren't many shops here, so you might find it\ninconvenient. I hope you'll get used to it.
Darn it! I'm running a little short on materials\nused for forging these days. Well, I can't find\nwhat I need around here in the first place.
I might find them in the forest up there, but it\ntakes time to go there, and it's a pain in the ass\nto meet the forest inhabitants. I've had enough!
So you should bring your own material.\nDon't feel bad about it!
Yo! Welcome, welcome!\nHiHi! Why don't you sit down and we talk?\nWhat's your request? Tell Me Please!
OK! Thanks, pal!\nPlease come again and See You!
Failed to receive the reward. The bag is full.\nPlease check the bag and report again.
You're not from this world, are you? You're from\nthe world we weredragons once were in, right?\nI knew it...People like you come here sometimes.
They say I'm using the technique that was being\nused in that world. It's 60-70% similar,\nbut many items are lost too because of me.
Life will be more convenient if the lost technique\ncan be used, but...I wonder if those who know to\nuse it will come to this world like you do...
Oh? Welcome!\nWhat can I do for you today? I have poor hearing,\nso please say it slowly and loudly.
That's all...? Alright. Just come again if you\nneed my help. If I'm sleeping inside, just scream\nout my name.

Oh, hello. Why don't you and I have a little talk?\nI think some chitchat with an old man like me\nisn't a bad idea to kill time...
So you already know about the propulsion system\nthat moves the huge rock mass that Draco Town is\non.
Hm...? I've never seen it either, but it must be\nbig because it can move this rock mass freely.
What? The supplier of the tools here?\nNo, no, no. Everything here is handmade by me.\nHehehe, don't be surprised.
I was born in a family where everyone's dexterous.\nIf it's just a simple tool, I can make it quickly.\nWell, other weredragons can make it too, but
It's cheaper to buy from me and they can get what\nthey need immediately. Good business for me.\nWell, I guess there are just too many lazy folks.
Hi, welcome! It's rare to see you here.\nWhat do you need today? There's nothing special\nhere, but please take your time.
Aight, thanks! Please come by again when you need\nsomething!

You can register your items and buy other\nplayers' items through this board.
Grandpa, I'm back. I brought some visitors from\nanother world here. Some of them are slightly\ninjured, can you take a look at them?
Let me introduce you to Grandpa Atu, the leader\nof this town.
I call him grandpa, but actually he's my grandpa's\nbrother...my granduncle I guess? He's a doctor and\nthe chieftain of the weredragon tribe.
Ooh, rare humans from another world...Your wounds\nseem to have been treated with first aid...\nBut it's better to treat them properly, lemme see.
Sorry, I've just realized I haven't introduced\nmyself properly. I see we have a Eumano warrior\nthat has become a Sproutling here. Then we have...
Oh my lord!\nA living Lixi is already rare, what's more\nsurprising is you're a rare species...
Hey! Which part of me looks like a Lixi?!\nIf you're the leader, that means you've been to\nour world, right?!
Don't tell me that you've never met the Cules\nbefore!!
Um? Ooh, the Cules! Yes, I've met them before.\nThe human species that are very greedy even though\nthey're small.
Sorry, I forgot about them because we weredragons\ndidn't interact much with them. Anyway, I'm glad\nyou made it here. Make sure you get a good rest.
Grandpa, you were right. Coenubias have invaded\nour territory. It seems that they're not only\ncoming from the crater...
Those darn Coenubias...so they've noticed this\nrock mass while wandering around the rock mass up\nthere...
They may be targeting the system that propels\nthis rock mass, or even the vital point of the\nweredragons...
The vital point of the weredragons?
The vital point of the weredragons you mean is...\nthat big chunk that is drifting outside right?\nWhat in the world is that?
It's the cocoon in which the new king dragon\nsleeps. It carries the rock mass on which the\nEumanos live and moves with it.
It doesn't only maintain the weredragon's\nterritory, but it also emits waves that enable the\nweredragons to adapt to the environment here...
T-that means it's really really important, right?
Yeah. Besides, these waves are also the power\nsource of the propulsion system that allows the\nweredragons' territory to move. If it falls into
the hands of Coenubias, both the Eumanos' world\nand the weredragons' world will be destroyed.\nThat's why we've been desperately protecting it.
By the way, you said that the weredragons built\nthe propulsion system here, did you already have\nsuch skills since you were in our world?
I might sound very rude, but from what we've\nheard, the weredragons really don't seem to be\ncapable of doing such a thing...
Hahaha, that's understandable.\nHumans seem to believe that there is not even a\nshred of intelligence in us.
That's because almost all of the weredragons who\nwent out to the human world were uncivilized.
But, many weredragons have learned about humans\nand various skills since we were in your world and\nwe've established an advance civilization...
Well, we're not good at developing a new or\noriginal technology though...The propulsion system\nthat enables this rock mass to move is
what we've created by combining the magic art of\nDarkan and Slebinian science that we've learned in\nyour world...
You called me Lixi earlier, what kind of species\nis it?
At first, we were unable to complete the\npropulsion system with just the skills we've\nlearned in your world and when we hit a dead end,
the most tech-savvy species that also knows how\nto use magic in this world offered to help us...\nAnd it was the Lixis...
Oh wow, so it's an amazing species.\nI wonder if Anono will be a genius if his memory\ncomes back.
...However, that was hundreds of years ago.\nThere is no more Lixi in the weredragons' world\nnow.
The entire species has been captured and\nmanipulated by Coenubias and sent out as their\nfront-line troops to invade various places.
Grandpa, I'm thinking of taking them to the vital\npoint of the weredragons. What do you think?
Hm, I'm sure Coenubias are targeting the vital\npoint of the weredragons...
I'm sorry but do you mind helping to protect it?
I think if we're going to fight Coenubias, we\nneed to know more about this world.\nOkay, we'll go!
Ah, wait a minute...\nTake this with you!\nI'm sure it'll be useful there...
You have received Weredragon's Handprint from\nLeader Atu!
...Therefore, I'd like to ask for your permission\nto repair the ark with the weredragon's\ntechnology. Please allow us!
Hm...\nI seem to have lost count of how many times I've\ncrossed paths with the gods from your world...
When I was young, there was a god who came here to\nlook for medicine for his daughter because of an\nunknown and contagious disease in your world.
My master, who was a doctor, made him some\nmedicine, but he needed someone to test it and\nthen I happened to contract the same disease...
T-that story...I've heard it so many times and\nit's stuck in my head now...That god is my father,\nObligaus...And his sick daughter was me!
Thank you! If the medicine hadn't been tested on\nyou back then, I might not be here now!
No! Without that experience, I don't think I would\nwant to be a doctor and I wouldn't be able to save\nmy community! I should thank you instead!!
Hm~...I never thought I'd really meet the daughter\nof the god in my grandpa's old story.
This is exactly what we call the wonder of the\nstrings of fate. We're seeing a pretty rare scene,\naren't we?
Ooh, I'm glad you guys are alright too!\nI was kinda worried, you know?
We weren't particularly worried about you.
Because we saw you were saved by the airship.\nI'm glad you are safe...
We were just concerned about the behavior of the\nship when it flew with you guys on board,\nthat's why we came here to ask Leader Atu.
Looking at the way it flew, I can't say that it\nwas perfect. I think it needs fixing.
We would like to get your permission to go and\nfix it. Would you allow us?
Oh, I didn't expect you guys would offer to fix\nit before we ask. Why though?
We believe that all mechanisms should work\nproperly.
A mechanism that works properly is full of beauty.
Seeing a mechanism that is not working properly is\ndepressing...
That's too difficult to understand.\nUse more simple words!
Really? Well...What if I say...\nA machine that is not working properly is\ndisgusting?
Ah! T-that's way more simple than before...
Leader Atu, allow me to ask you once again too.\nPlease give us your permission to repair the ark!
The propulsion system is managed by Kunst,\nMenberg, and Harstel. If they're involved,\nthere's nothing to worry about. Do your best!
Alright, let's get started now.\nFirst, I'd like you to collect the things we need\nto fix the ark.
See, I knew it!\nWhat do you want us to collect?
There are many things, but almost all of them can\nbe obtained by beating monsters...
The magnetic substance from the head of the giant\nbird type monster nesting in the rocky mountains\nvisible from the plains is difficult to get, but
We absolutely need it if we wanna make use of the\nenergy generated by the force field...
I-I have a bad feeling...\nBut fine, we'll collect it for you!!
You asked Zianga to escort Kunon and the three\nhomunculi to Country Road, the place where the ark\nis...
Huh? Oh, okay.\nWe'll meet you at the ark then.\nBe careful and come back safely!
Ride the Wind Ark to Labrum Atoll?
